data.name: Afraah
data.gender_notes: Afraah is used as a female name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Afraah means 'joy' or 'happiness' in Islamic tradition. It is derived from the Arabic word 'firah' which means happiness. The name Afraah carries the meaning “Joy, Happiness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Afraah usually hope their child will grow to embody joy, happiness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Afraah is a reminder of God's blessings and the joy that comes from faith.
data.etymology: Afraah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joy, Happiness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Afraah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: أفراح
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على الفرح والسرور في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أفراح هو جمع فرح، ويعني الفرح الشديد والسعادة العميقة، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَيُدخِلُهُمُ الجِنانَ الَّتي وَصَفَها لَهُم في القُرانِ' (سورة الفرقان، آية 56)، وقد استخدم هذا الاسم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية كتعبير عن الفرح والسعادة

in_urdu.name: افراح
in_urdu.long_meaning: افراح نام کا مطلب ہے گہری خوشی اور فرح، جو عربی زبان کے 'فرح' سے ماخوذ ہے، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں فرح و خوشی کے اظہار کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے، اور اس کا ذکر مختلف فارسی اور عربی مصادر میں ملتا ہے

in_hindi.name: अफराह
in_hindi.meaning: गहरी खुशी और आनंद का अर्थ
in_hindi.long_meaning: अफराह नाम का अर्थ है गहरी खुशी और आनंद, जो अरबी भाषा के 'فرح' (फराह) से लिया गया है, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में खुशी और आनंद के प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है, और इसकी जड़ें इस्लामी परंपरा में हैं

in_pashto.name: افراح
in_pashto.long_meaning: افراح نوم د ژورې خوښۍ او فرح معنی لري، چې د عربي ژبې د 'فرح' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو کلتورونو کې د خوښۍ او فرح د څرګندولو په توګه کارول کیږي

in_english.name: Afraah
in_english.long_meaning: Afraah is derived from the Arabic root 'فرح' (farah), meaning deep joy and happiness, it has been used in various Islamic cultures to express delight and cheerfulness, and is mentioned in several Quranic verses and Islamic traditions

data.cultural_impact: The name Afraah is considered a beautiful and joyful name in Islamic culture. It evokes feelings of happiness and positivity. It is also a popular name for both boys and girls in various Arab and Muslim communities around the world.
data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, the name Afraah holds deep significance as a reminder of the joy and happiness that comes from living a meaningful and God-conscious life. In Islam, joy and happiness are considered essential elements of faith and are highly valued. By carrying this name, one is constantly reminded to seek joy and happiness through following the guidance of God and living a righteous life. Ultimately, the name Afraah serves as a source of inspiration and motivation to live a life filled with happiness and purpose.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Afraah is derived from the Arabic word "afrah," which means "dawn" or "early morning." In Islamic tradition, this name symbolizes the start of a new day and the promise of new beginnings, as well as the brightness and light that comes with the dawn. It is a reminder of the wisdom and beauty found in the natural world and the importance of seizing the opportunities that each day brings.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Afraah is mentioned in the Hadith as a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Afraah carried significant weight in that era.
